attributes.title: Level 6

subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓ Which Boolean operator checks if 1 of 2 conditions is true?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ What code should be added so that the project checks if the user’s guess is equal to the first random number OR if the user’s guess is equal to the second random number?


Solution: 

|| userGuess == randNum2 should be added inside the parentheses of the if condition on Line 16.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, it only checks if the user’s guess is equal to 1 of the 2 random number variables. 


Fix the bugs in the code so that the project checks if the user’s guess is equal to either the first OR second random number variables.

subgroups.title: Debugging Boolean OR Operators
subgroups.introduction: Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!

validationItems.text: || userGuess == randNum2 added inside the parentheses of the if condition on Line 16.
validationItems.failureText: Try updating the conditions checked for inside the parentheses of the if/else conditional.

subgroups.name: solve 2

steps.hints: ❓ Which variables should be used so that the project checks if the user’s guess is equal to the first, second, or third random numbers?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Which variables should the project check if the user’s guess is equal to?


Solution: 

Variables changed from randNum1 to randNum2 and randNum3 in the second and third conditions inside the parentheses under // 2 digit number
steps.instructions:
After the 2-digit number is entered, the project only checks if the user’s guess is equal to the first random number. 


Fix the bugs in the code so that the project checks if the user’s guess is equal to the first, second, OR third random number.

subgroups.title: Debugging Boolean OR Operators
subgroups.introduction: Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!

validationItems.text: variables changed to randNum2 and randNum3 in the second and third conditions inside the parentheses under // 2 digit number.
validationItems.failureText: Check the variable names used inside the parentheses of the if condition under // 2 digit number.

subgroups.name: solve 3

steps.hints: ❓ Which symbols create a Boolean OR operator?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Which symbols should be replaced inside the parentheses of the if condition under // 3-digit number.?


Solution: 

Boolean AND operators && inside the parentheses of 3-digit if condition should be replaced with Boolean OR operators ||.
steps.instructions:
After the 3-digit number is entered, the project checks if the user’s guess was equal to the first, second, third, AND fourth random number. 


Fix the bugs in the code so the project only checks if the user’s guess was equal to the first, second, third, OR fourth random number.

subgroups.title: Debugging Boolean OR Operators
subgroups.introduction: Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!

validationItems.text: && operators inside parentheses of 3-digit if condition are replaced with ||.
validationItems.failureText: Try updating the Boolean operators used in the if condition under // 3-digit number.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 6 of Blue Belt! Before you create your final Blue Belt project, there are a few neat tricks to learn that could take your game to the next level! In this level, you’ll learn more about Boolean and relational operators, which can be used to check if 1 or more conditions are true in a project. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 6:

badges.title: Making Big Decisions
badges.description: Use Boolean and relational operators as part of conditional statements in JavaScript.

badges.title: Package Deal
badges.description: Use a Boolean AND operator in JavaScript.

badges.title: Hard Pressed
badges.description: Check if a button is pressed as part of a conditional statement.

badges.title: Comparatively Speaking
badges.description: Use a relational operator in JavaScript.

badges.title: Reassess the Situation
badges.description: Use an assignment operator to give an existing variable a new value.

badges.title: This or That
badges.description: Use a Boolean OR operator in JavaScript.
